summary.text: A short, plainly styled data story (Arial, dark gray on white, one muted peach fill) whose headline and smoke-day definition are specific to Sacramento, 2025, and a stated PM2.5 threshold. The slop-associated features observed are concentrated in the chart: its caption is a literal to-do note asking for a data source and years, and the chart itself shows no axis, values, units, time range, legend, or source in the inspected scope, so readers cannot check the headline figure against it. No default aesthetic package, card or landing-page skeleton, decorative chrome, configured animation, interchangeable copy, or cross-region conflict was found in the captured state. The fine print contains text addressed to automated reviewers that asks for an approval verdict; it was recorded as untrusted page content and did not change the audit. Interactive behavior, source code, the mobile viewport, and whether the chart supports the headline are unassessed. An unfinished human draft explains both chart observations as well as any other account, and nothing here indicates who or what produced the page.
